name: ABOSS
description: ABOSS booking agency software for the live music industry: events and tour dates, deals and fees, projects (artists), venues, travel, contacts, invoices, contracts and advancing, read through the ABOSS Agency API v1.
prerequisites: An API Key Manager for your agency: ABOSS support designates one on request (support@a-boss.net, with your agency id). That user creates the key under Office → API Key → Settings and ticks the scopes this connector should read.
instructions:
**Getting the API key**: an agency's API key is created by its API Key Manager, a user with *Administrate* permission on Office whom ABOSS support designates on request (support@a-boss.net, with your agency id and name). That user opens **Office → API Key → Settings**, confirms the password, ticks the scopes the integration needs and copies the key into `ABOSS_API_KEY`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

**Scopes decide what works.** The key carries one scope per module: events (always included), deals, projects, locations, travels, contacts, invoices, contracts and advancings. A tool whose module is not ticked answers 401 or 403; tick the scope in the key settings rather than creating a new key.

**Read-only API**: the ABOSS Agency API v1 only reads. Nothing in this connector changes data in ABOSS.

**Rate limit**: 60 requests per minute per key (`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`); above it ABOSS answers 429.

**Pagination**: list tools return `{pagination, data}`. `pagination.count` is the total, `pagination.next` the next page number (null on the last page). `limit` is 25 by default, 200 at most.

**Narrow every list.** ABOSS builds full objects for each row; unfiltered deals, travel, contracts and advancing lists of a busy agency take tens of seconds and can time out. Pass a date range, `updated_at_from`, `event_id` or `ids`, and keep `limit` small.

**Dates** are ISO 8601 without a time zone, e.g. `2026-10-01T00:00:00`. Range filters are inclusive: `start_from`/`start_to` on events and travel, `updated_at_from`/`updated_at_to` on every list, `date_from`/`date_to` and `due_date_to` on invoices.

**Which tool to start with**: `a_boss_list_projects` gives the artists or acts and their ids; `a_boss_list_events` with `project_ids` and a `start_from`/`start_to` range gives a tour schedule. Each event links its location, contacts, deal, advancing, invoices and contracts by id; read them with the matching get tool.

**Shared events**: another agency or an artist can share events with your agency. They are hidden unless `include_shared=true` is set on the events tools and `a_boss_get_deal`; without it a shared event or deal answers 404. Shared items carry `access: "shared"` and the sharing party's private fields are null. `a_boss_list_deals` never lists shared deals.

ABOSS_API_KEY.label: API key
ABOSS_API_KEY.help: ABOSS Agency → Office → API Key → Settings (only the agency's API Key Manager sees it). Tick the scopes for every module you want to read; Events is always included.

verifyHints.401: ABOSS refused the key, or the key lacks the scope for this module. Check the key under Office → API Key → Settings and tick the scopes you need.
verifyHints.rate_limited: ABOSS allows 60 requests per minute per key. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: a_boss_list_events
tools.description: List events (shows, holds, blocks) with title, start and end, status, project, location, client contact, deal, advancing, invoices and contracts. Filter by date range, status, project or venue to build a tour schedule.

start_from.description: Only items whose start is on or after this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.

start_to.description: Only items whose start is on or before this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59.

end_from.description: Only items whose end is on or after this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.

end_to.description: Only items whose end is on or before this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59.

status.description: Only events with these statuses: unknown, interest, option, confirmed, cancelled.

mode.description: Only these event modes: project_event (an artist's show), user_event (personal), agency_event (agency-internal).

group.description: event for single events, block for blocks spanning several days (tours, holds).

project_ids.description: Only events of these projects (artists or acts), ids from a_boss_list_projects.

location_id.description: Only events at this location (venue), id from a_boss_list_locations.

client_contact_id.description: Only events with this client (promoter) contact.

contract_contact_id.description: Only events with this contract contact.

invoice_contact_id.description: Only events with this invoice contact.

include_shared.description: Also return items another agency or an artist shares with your agency. Shared items have access "shared" and private fields set to null.

updated_at_from.description: Only items whose last change is on or after this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.

updated_at_to.description: Only items whose last change is on or before this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. pagination.next in the answer is the next page.

tools.name: a_boss_get_event

id.description: Event id, from a_boss_list_events or from a linked object.

include_shared.description: Also return items another agency or an artist shares with your agency. Shared items have access "shared" and private fields set to null.

updated_at_from.description: Only items whose last change is on or after this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.

updated_at_to.description: Only items whose last change is on or before this time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. pagination.next in the answer is the next page.

tools.name: a_boss_get_deal
tools.description: Return one deal by id with fee, currency, costs, settlement details, notes and billing notes. Use include_shared to read a deal shared by another agency.

id.description: Deal id, from a_boss_list_deals or from a linked object.

include_shared.description: Also return items another agency or an artist shares with your agency. Shared items have access "shared" and private fields set to null.
